name: AEROSPACE Earbuds White
description: White curved earpieces and silver star-shaped details give AEROSPACE a lighter, layered silhouette.
fullDescription: AEROSPACE White balances the collection's sharp star motif with pale curved earpieces. Silver details trace the front of the design, while the white background makes the individual shapes and their connections easy to read. The result keeps AEROSPACE's jewellery-inspired character with a lighter overall appearance. The same design is also available in Black and Silver through the colour selector.

specifications.label: Design details
specifications.value: Curved earpieces, sculptural stars and rectangular decorative accents
